verdict.rationale: Manufact only mentions a monthly spend limit for metered usage and a credit-based billing system, with no documented per-tool-call pricing or rate limits in the docs; community feedback explicitly confirms the pricing/credit system is unclear and buyers can't see pay-as-you-go costs before committing. Missing for 10: transparent per-call/connection pricing tables, documented rate limits, and independent confirmation that cost visibility works pre-signup.
